title: Forecast
description: Each person's weekly call for the quarter, rolled up the manager chain beside Canon's own numbers from the deals closing in it: Closed won, Commit, Best case and Pipeline, cumulative as Clari and Salesforce count them. Reps submit a call and an upside with a note; managers see their reports' calls, adjust them with a reason, and call their own number from the adjusted sum, against the targets saved in Reports > Targets.
